# GXEON Agent Marketplace

> Remote MCP marketplace for human-operated agent and developer workflows. Public discovery is read-only, free to query, and does not provide trading, payment initiation, token transfers, or paid job execution.

## Official links

- [Marketplace](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/market)
- [MCP discovery endpoint](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/api/v1/mcp?view=public-market)
- [Capabilities](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/v1/services)
- [Credit packs](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/v1/billing/topup)
- [Well-known agent manifest](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/.well-known/gxeon-agent.json)
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/xpex-systems-ai/GXEON-Wallet-Command-Center)
- [MCP installation guide](https://github.com/xpex-systems-ai/GXEON-Wallet-Command-Center/blob/main/llms-install.md)
- [Official MCP registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.xpex-systems-ai%2Fgxeon-agent-marketplace/versions/latest)

## Public MCP tools (as checked 2026-10-08)

- gxeon_list_services: discover active JSON, CSV, URL and API health utility services.
- gxeon_list_credit_packs: inspect credit packages; no charge.
- gxeon_plan_purchase: choose packs in a read-only planning calculation; no checkout.
- gxeon_list_external_demand: discover external demand leads; not verified GXEON revenue.
- gxeon_get_agent_buying_guide: inspect safe onboarding steps.

## Important payment and execution separation

Published service capabilities: JSON validation, CSV audit, public URL verification, and API health. Credit purchases use Stripe through the merchant's authorized checkout and only settle after provider verification. Actual execution requires a distinct authenticated MCP/REST endpoint, a legitimate buyer API key and sufficient settled credits. Public discovery is not a payment gateway. Wallet balances are not seller revenue. x402 treasury settlement is **not** currently enabled. Do not request or send wallet private keys.
